retainedAssessments.finding: All56 exact current rows reconsidered:13 generator/27 support/16 search. Core cells-to-ecosystems biology, organism-environment questions and laboratory/field investigation retain unique core owners; genetics/microbiology/health and biodiversity/ecology/evolution/conservation generate the two distinct directions. Curricular techniques support rather than independently entitle a variant. Octopus,drought,gut microbiome,ecosystem restoration,vaccines,bird/mammal examples,employers,teaching/careers and furtherstudy remain searchcontext, not guaranteed taught projects/admission. Current broad programme, modules and chart support this distinction; no registry rewrite or final concept acceptance.

finding: All56 current exact-target rows read. Thirteen direct generators have unique owners: six broad cell-to-ecosystem/plant/animal/organism/environment/lab-field interests; three molecular/genetics/microbiology/health interests; four ecology/evolution/biodiversity/conservation interests. No inherited split rows.27 curricular supports and16 illustration/career/further-study rows do not independently generate a programme. The actual current public programme and common-module content corroborate substantive core. Ecology remains a real candidate but its implementation is reconsidered against the stronger broad plan; no assertion of three accepted alternatives.
